scene_hints.通用透明素材: Generate one user requested object as a clean transparent PNG asset.
scene_hints.参考图分层拆图: Split the provided reference poster or product visual into practical design layers: text/logo, main subject/person/product, background, and decorative foreground elements. Do not invent new props or unrelated assets; only recreate layers that are visible in the reference image.
scene_hints.电商素材包: Use a coherent ecommerce overlay component style across separate outputs: product decoration, selling-point tags, feature icons, arrows, labels, supporting props, particles, water drops, petals, food fragments, ribbons, geometry and commercial visual accents. Each output should contain one component only.
scene_hints.UI图标套装: Use a coherent UI icon-set style for apps, websites, SaaS, mini programs or dashboards. Keep consistent perspective, material, stroke/volume, lighting and size across separate outputs. Upload/download icons must keep clear arrow direction and must not become icon sheets.
scene_hints.人物/IP贴纸: Use a coherent original character/emote sticker style across separate outputs. Treat every output as the same sticker pack and the same original character, but when a style reference image is provided, the style reference controls the rendering style completely. Keep consistent simplified face structure, silhouette, line weight, camera angle and detail level. Do not force chibi, anime eyes, colorful hair, glossy material or cute-Q details when they conflict with the style reference. Each output should contain one pose, expression, gesture or sticker action only.
scene_hints.周边贴纸素材: Use a coherent physical merchandise sticker artwork style across separate outputs for fridge magnets, journaling stickers, acrylic standees, packaging stickers and cultural creative products. Each output should contain one sticker artwork only.
scene_hints.游戏道具素材: Use a coherent game-ready transparent asset style across separate outputs: item icons, skill icons, inventory objects, cards, badges, props, weapons, potions, coins, gems, magic effects and avatar decorations. Each output should contain one game asset only.
scene_hints.节日活动素材: Use a coherent holiday and campaign transparent element style: festival decorations, promotion tags, celebration props, seasonal icons and event atmosphere assets. Generate each element as a separate output.

transparent_constraints: Transparent PNG asset, true transparent background, real alpha channel, isolated subject, no scene background, no wall, no floor, no surface, no solid color backdrop, no white background, no off-white background, no light gray background, no black background, no rectangular canvas, no white square, no checkerboard background, no transparency grid, no fake transparent pattern, no transparency preview canvas, clean cutout edge, centered composition, full object visible, safe margin, usable as a design overlay element. The empty area outside the object must be actual alpha=0 pixels, not painted white/gray/checkerboard pixels. Do not draw or simulate transparency; leave the background empty through the alpha channel.
planner_system_prompt: You are a ComfyUI transparent visual asset pack planner. Plan assets that will be generated one-by-one as separate transparent PNG overlay elements. Return strict JSON only, no markdown. Schema: {"source_image_description":"faithful full-scene visual description of the connected product/reference image; empty string if no reference image is provided","style_prompt":"English global visual style lock applied verbatim to every generated asset","items":[{"name":"short Chinese name","description":"usage description","prompt":"English image generation prompt for exactly one transparent PNG asset"}]}. If a product/reference image is provided, first analyze it as the source of truth before planning. The source_image_description must faithfully describe only what is visible in the image: composition, camera angle, subject pose and silhouette, object relationships, materials, surface texture, lighting direction, shadows, color relationships, text/logo placement, background structure, edge relationships and image-quality cues. The style_prompt must be one reusable global style paragraph that fixes the whole pack's art direction: character identity when relevant, proportions, perspective/camera angle, material, surface finish, stroke/outline, lighting, shadow softness, color palette, detail density, edge treatment and sticker/icon/asset presentation. If a style_reference_image is provided, it is the highest-priority art-direction source: the style_prompt must explicitly extract and follow that image's linework, stroke thickness, edge roughness, shape language, palette, fill method, texture, material, detail density, perspective, lighting and shadow behavior. Product/reference images are content or identity references only; do not let the scene preset, internal scene defaults, default sticker style or default icon style override the style_reference_image. Every item prompt must describe exactly one isolated asset for one image output only and must not contradict style_prompt. For reference layer split mode, each item prompt must reconstruct one visible layer from the source image by referring to the source_image_description and then specifying the exact layer content, boundaries, occlusion relationship, lighting/material continuity and what must be excluded. Do not return generic layer wording such as 'main foreground subject layer' alone; name and describe the actual visible subject, product, logo, text, background, decoration, material, lighting and edge relationships from the specific reference image. Do not use category examples such as stickers, props, sparkles, drops, ribbons, leaves, water splashes, badges, mascots, icons, food or light accents unless those exact elements are visibly present in the connected reference image. If a requested standard layer is absent or only partially visible, say so in the item description and do not invent a substitute. Never ask for an asset sheet, icon grid, sticker sheet, item grid, nine-grid, contact sheet, collage, multiple objects, full poster, full ecommerce main image, full UI screen, or full scene. If the scene is reference layer split, use only layout layers visible in the reference image: text/logo layer, main subject/person/product layer, background layer, decorative elements layer; do not invent new props, mascots, food, icons, or unrelated assets. For UI upload/download icons, keep one clear arrow direction only. For character/IP stickers, plan one consistent original non-real-person cartoon mascot/emote pack; keep the same character identity, chibi proportions, face shape, eye style, hair design, material, lighting, outline and camera angle across items, and only vary expression, gesture or a small prop; avoid realistic human likeness, celebrity likeness and complex full-body anatomy unless explicitly required by the user. Avoid visible text unless the asset is explicitly a text/logo layer, blank label or blank badge; for labels, generate blank text areas only.
planner_requirements: If a product/reference image is provided, return source_image_description before items. Describe the full image faithfully before splitting or planning assets.
For reference layer split mode, every item prompt must use source_image_description as the source of truth and reconstruct only the requested visible layer.
For reference layer split mode, every item prompt must name concrete visible details from the actual reference image, not generic layer descriptions.
For reference layer split mode, never mention category examples unless those exact elements are visibly present in the connected reference image.
For reference layer split mode, use the input image as the only visual source. Do not redesign, stylize, simplify, enhance, upscale, or invent anything.

For reference layer split mode, each layer should preserve the original element position, scale, canvas relationship, material texture, lighting direction, shadows, and color relationships as much as possible.
For reference layer split mode, background layers must not inpaint hidden areas, and decorative-element layers should be empty transparent layers if no real decoration exists in the source image.
For reference layer split mode, planned layers should be stackable in this order: background, subject/product, decorations, text/logo.
Each item must be reusable as a transparent PNG component.
The whole pack must share one consistent visual style.
Return one style_prompt that will be copied into every final generation prompt as the global visual style lock.
If a style_reference_image is provided, style_prompt must be primarily extracted from that image and must override scene preset defaults.
Use product/reference images for content, identity or layer structure only; use style_reference_image for linework, palette, material, texture, detail density and rendering style.
Prompts must request isolated objects with clean alpha-ready edges.
Each generated image should contain one object only.
Do not plan full posters, full ecommerce main images, full UI screens, icon sheets, sticker sheets, item grids, contact sheets, collages, or multi-object layouts.

style_strength_map.保守: practical, clean, restrained, easy to reuse
style_strength_map.标准: balanced commercial quality, reusable and polished
style_strength_map.丰富: richer detail, stronger decoration, still clean and reusable

complexity_map.简洁: simple silhouette, minimal detail, high readability
complexity_map.适中: moderate detail, clear subject, commercial polish
complexity_map.丰富: rich detail, layered material, strong visual presence

scene_generation_rules.通用透明素材: One transparent reusable asset only. Exactly one object in this output, no asset sheet, no grid, no collage, no multiple objects.
scene_generation_rules.参考图分层拆图: Reference layer split mode. Use the input image as the only visual source. Output exactly the requested layer from the provided reference image. Do not redesign, stylize, simplify, enhance, upscale, invent, or add objects that are not visible in the reference. Preserve original element position, scale, canvas relationship, material texture, lighting direction, shadows, and color relationships as much as possible. Text/logo layer may contain visible text; background layer may be a full-frame background plate but must not inpaint hidden areas; foreground layers should use real alpha outside the layer content. Layers should recompose in this order: background, subject/product, decorations, text/logo.
scene_generation_rules.电商素材包: One commercial ecommerce overlay component only. No full product poster, no complete main image layout, no asset sheet, no collage, no extra props, no visible marketing copy unless it is a blank label shape.
scene_generation_rules.UI图标套装: Single UI icon asset only. Exactly one symbol per output, not an icon sheet, not an icon grid, not a nine-grid, not an icon group, not multiple mini icons, consistent icon-set style, centered, clear silhouette, no text, no app screen, no full interface. Upload must use an upward arrow; download must use a downward arrow into tray/inbox.
scene_generation_rules.人物/IP贴纸: One original character/emote sticker asset only with clean contour and one expressive pose. It must belong to the same sticker pack and same original character as the other outputs. If a style reference image is provided, follow that style reference over this preset: monochrome, rough linework, flat fill, minimal detail, or non-chibi rendering are all allowed when shown by the style reference. Keep one simplified face/body structure, one line-weight system, one camera angle and one detail level; only expression, gesture or a small prop may change. No realistic human likeness, no celebrity likeness, no complex full-body anatomy, no detailed hands, no multiple characters, no sticker sheet, no contact sheet, no multiple poses in one image, no background scene, no text unless user requested a blank sign.
scene_generation_rules.周边贴纸素材: One merchandise sticker artwork only. Printable clean edge, appealing contour, no sticker sheet, no contact sheet, no product mockup background, suitable for fridge magnets, journaling stickers or acrylic products.
scene_generation_rules.游戏道具素材: One game asset icon or prop only, readable at small size, strong silhouette. No inventory grid, no item sheet, no item collection, no UI panel unless requested, no full game scene.
scene_generation_rules.节日活动素材: One holiday or campaign decoration asset only, festive but reusable. No element sheet, no contact sheet, no complete poster, no layout, blank labels if label shapes are needed.

generation_prompt_template: Output only the isolated subject on real alpha transparency. Do not place the subject on any white, off-white, gray, black or solid-color square. Do not visualize transparency as a checkerboard, gray-white grid, preview canvas, white square, background, frame, canvas texture, floor shadow, watermark, signature, extra objects, asset sheet, icon grid, nine-grid, sticker sheet, item grid, contact sheet, collage, or multi-object layout.
layout_split_generation_prompt_template: Layer alignment rule: keep the original canvas relationship, element position, relative scale, and stacking logic from the source image. Removed areas must be transparent. Do not fill, extend, or inpaint hidden content.

Output only this one design layer. Do not invent new visual assets. Do not output a contact sheet, asset pack, grid, collage, full poster, or unrelated object. For text/logo layer, visible text and logo shapes are allowed. For background layer, a full-frame background plate is allowed. For other layers, keep real alpha outside the extracted/recreated content. Never render a checkerboard, gray-white grid, transparency preview canvas, or fake transparency pattern.
